range_contract: Both recurrence states in every lane of an AVX2 f32 packet, after applying the lane exponent by exact exponent-field adjustment, lie in the existing FusedSynthesisBlock CHECK_RANGE interval [SMALL, BIG], allowing exact zero.
timing_status: instrumented census only; timings contended and not used

measurement_method.state_samples: each full AVX2 f32 packet at each visited degree pair in the existing paired recurrence fallback; both previous/current mantissas are exponent-adjusted exactly by exponent-field reconstruction
measurement_method.eligibility: all eight lanes of both recurrence states are zero or exactly within the existing FusedSynthesisBlock CHECK_RANGE interval [SMALL, BIG]
measurement_method.suffix_unit: individual coefficient degree × latitude contribution slots from first eligible pair to lmax; odd final degree included
measurement_method.later_safety: recorded if any later visited pair for that packet exits the same range
measurement_method.scope_limit: recurrence-state eligibility only; coefficient-product and accumulation safety remain guarded by the existing fused kernel and transactional fallback and were not included in this census; non-vector tails and polar-mixed blocks remain on fallback
